sourceAddressPolicy: Printed תצו, source12:5 starts וימיתו after the preceding combined3–4 unit ends און׃ in the row whose right margin is ה. It continues through the complete following row, ending ההוזים׃ before the next row marked ו begins ואבות. Preserve both source rows, every bracket and the source5 label; do not start5 at the beginning of the margin-labeled row, which still contains the prior unit ending.

inspections.finding: Chrome extension zoom4 shows a narrow complete vav stem above a broad horizontal basal mark. The mark projects to both sides of the stem and has no downward central tail. The initial vav in the complete same-unit וימיתו has the same horizontal patah-at-foot contour. Literal vav in ואבות instead shows the narrow vertical two-node sheva formation, and final shuruq-vav inside the bracketed word has no below-letter enlargement. Literal qamats beneath resh in קרבים and he in העולם has a further downward stem absent here. Certify patah U+05B7 after the initial vav at baseline scalar61. This decision is made from the Chrome reader pixels; the original binary PDF image alone was insufficiently decisive.

Chrome extension zoom4 preserves two separate dark dots stacked vertically below the complete resh stem. White separations distinguish the upper dot from the stem and the two dots from one another; the adjacent ayin lower stroke stays to the right. The gimel in complete מפגרי and qof in complete קרבים provide literal separated sheva pairs, while resh in טורפים supplies a joined same-letter vertical example. Resh qamats in קרבים has a horizontal top and downward stem, and resh tsere in מפגרי is horizontally arranged. The target is the separated vertical pair. Certify sheva U+05B0 after resh at baseline scalar67, preserving the prior yod and ayin points and all bracket scalars.

Chrome extension zoom4 shows the complete first he with a distinct broad horizontal mark below and slightly left of its right stem. The mark has no central downward stem or separate side pair. Literal he patah in הקים provides the same compact horizontal structure. He qamats in העולם has a clear downward stem, he hataf-patah in להקת adds a separate side pair, and final he in אתה has no below-letter mark. These whole-word and whole-glyph controls identify patah U+05B7 after first he at baseline scalar127. The adjacent second he, vav holam, zayin hiriq and final punctuation remain unchanged.
